title: Trigger compatibility: FileMaker Go (iOS)
description: Script triggers in scope whose event does not fire, fires only partially, or has no published compatibility statement in FileMaker Go (iOS). Source: Claris trigger-compatibility table (fm_spec trigger_compat, fm-spec 2.8.0+, tri-state: Yes/No/Partial), joined over the SaXML slot id - never over the raw event name. The owner (layout, layout object or file) and the script are both listed; the script is the navigation anchor.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A trigger event Claris marks 'No' never fires in FileMaker Go (iOS) - the attached script is dead on that runtime; 'Partial' events fire under conditions documented on the event's Claris help page.
rule.remediation: Move the logic to an event that fires on the target runtime, or guard the script so the behaviour without the trigger is acceptable; for 'Partial' events read the trigger notes on the Claris help page.
